svg.title: The quality gate advises
svg.desc: The assembled page is rendered at 390 pixels and 1440 pixels. Free checks for unexplained jargon and reading level run first. A vision critic then grades eleven axes and six operator questions. Pages that reach mean 90, minimum 85 and all six YES are exemplary. Pages at mean 82, minimum 70 and the five ship questions YES ship. A page below that still ships, with its weakest axis disclosed. Delivery is refused only for integrity failures.
svg.text: the quality gate advises, it does not veto
1 · render for real
the assembled page in a real browser at 390px (phone) and 1440px
(desktop), full-page screenshots
2 · free checks first
INV-20 unexplained jargon and INV-24 reads-at-fifteen are measured
with no model call. A failure is recorded and the vision pass is
skipped
3 · the vision critic
grades section crops on 11 axes (A1-A6 substance, B1-B5 craft) and
six operator questions. A page near the line (mean 79-85) is graded
twice and the two samples merged
exemplary
mean 90+ · min axis 85+ · all six YES
ships
mean 82+ · min axis 70+ · five ship questions YES ·
both diagrams present
below the bar
still ships, with its weakest axis named to the
requester
A weak axis reopens just that slot (at most 3 grading passes). Deploy
refuses only on integrity: an unassembled page, a different repo than
the one submitted, a page linking files it does not ship, or no
scorecard with no recorded reason.
